'''Volume 65''' is the 65th volume of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is both the fourth and final volume in the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}<!--and the first volume in the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}}-->. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]].

==Trivia==
* The release date for this volume was delayed multiple times. It was initially scheduled to release on October 27, 2023, but was subsequently delayed to January 26, 2024, March 28, 2024, May 28, 2024, September 27, 2024, December 27, 2024, December 26, 2025, and June 26, 2026. The latter date, though, seems to be a placeholder since [[Satoshi Yamamoto]] [https://x.com/satoshi_swalot/status/2006344884375147004 stated] the actual release date is yet to be confirmed.
